title: Proposal 1: Constitutional convention
question: Should Michigan hold a convention of elected delegates in 2027 to rewrite the state constitution?
yes: Starts a rewrite of the whole constitution. Voters would still have to approve the final document. Some Republican legislative leaders have voiced support.
no: Keeps the constitution as written. Opposed by a coalition of business, labor and voting-rights groups, and by candidates from both parties including Benson and James.

lean.no: Benson, James, and a bipartisan business/labor coalition

title: Proposal 2: Money out of politics
question: Ban campaign contributions from regulated utilities and large government contractors, and expand disclosure rules for political ads, including online.
yes: Becomes law; it would take a three-quarters vote of the Legislature to change. Backed by Michiganders for Money Out of Politics, funded largely by national progressive groups.
no: Keeps current rules. Opposed by Protect MI Free Speech, funded by business groups including Consumers Energy's parent, Blue Cross and Comcast.
